title: Mrs Geeslin & Betty, 1945 1940s B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A 1945 vintage black and white snapshot photograph depicting two women identified on the reverse as Mrs. Geeslin and Betty. They are standing outdoors on a sidewalk beside a palm tree on a bright, sunny day. The younger woman on the left wears a printed short-sleeved 1940s day dress with light socks and loafers, while the older woman on the right wears a dark skirt suit with a folded clutch purse and glasses. In the background, a vintage automobile is parked along a quiet neighborhood street.
